errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the axes of the horizontal bar chart. The vertical axis lists the categories (мерки), and the horizontal axis represents the values (процента), not the other way around.
The chart displays 13 different measures, not 12.
The value axis (horizontal axis) is not labeled with numerical values. The percentages are shown as data labels next to each bar.
